summary: Iteration 5 — EXHAUSTIVE frontend audit of Papelería · Acomodo (Vite+React, 100% frontend). 32/32 reviewed flows PASS. The iteration_4 critical bug (drag/resize NOT being committed to history) is now FIXED in /app/frontend/src/components/ImageBox.jsx: both startDrag (lines 32-37) and startResize (lines 69-74) now declare `let committed = false;` and call `commit()` on the first onMove (one snapshot per gesture). Verified: drag 100px+80px then Ctrl+Z restores the placement to its exact original position (dx=0.0, dy=0.0) and resize via 'se' handle (+80x/+60y, w 219->299) then Ctrl+Z restores width exactly (dw=0.0). RESULTS PER FLOW: (1) APP LOADS with all expected testids (undo-button, redo-button, ine-mode-toggle, guillotine-mode-toggle, snap-grid-toggle, clear-all-button, export-button, file-input, paper-size-select, orientation-select, margin-slider, layout-{auto,half,2x2,3x3,4x4,full,ine}, clear-canvas-button, canvas-workspace, page-count). (2) 4 PNG images uploaded via file-input -> 4 thumbnails with compressed src (lengths [2995, 2975, 3187, 2751] all < 100000). (3) Double-click thumb -> 1 canvas-placement. (4) Direct DRAG-DROP from OS (synthetic DragEvent with dataTransfer.files on canvas-workspace) created BOTH thumb and placement automatically (cnt=1, thumbs=1). (5) Duplicate ID uniqueness re-confirmed in flow 6. (6) BUG FIX VERIFIED: 1 image + dblclick + 3 duplicates -> 4 placements; layout-2x2 -> 4 placements remain in 2x2 grid (NOT 1). (7) 9 copies + layout-3x3 -> 9 placements. (8) layout-auto from 6 images (no prior placements) -> 6 placements (image-based fallback works). (9) layout-full with 5 images -> page-count='5 hojas', 5 placements. (10) layout-half with 7 images -> page-count='4 hojas', 7 placements (3 hojas con 2 + 1 hoja con 1 = OK). (11) PDF export: %PDF magic bytes OK, size=64272 bytes. (12) PNG export: \x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n magic bytes OK, size=176224 bytes. (13) JPG export: \xff\xd8\xff magic bytes OK, size=60976 bytes. (14) Multi-page PDF: 3 images + layout-full -> single PDF with 3 /Type /Page objects, size=262420 bytes. (15) Undo button enabled after placement, click undo -> 0 placements, click redo -> 1 placement. (16) Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Y, Ctrl+Shift+Z all work as expected. (17) Undo of drag restores original position EXACTLY (the iter_4 fix). (18) Undo of resize restores original width EXACTLY. (19) INE toggle activates ine-mode-indicator AND ine-mode-panel AND layout-ine button. (20) INE layout with 1 image -> 2 placements (frente+reverso). (21) INE layout with 4 images -> 4 placements / 2 hojas (matches review spec '2 hojas con 2 placements por hoja'). (22) Guillotine toggle adds purple dashed border around each placement; 'g' keyboard shortcut also toggles. (23) Selecting a placement reveals all editor buttons: fit-contain, fit-cover, duplicate, reset-edit, lock-toggle, delete-placement, process-as-ine. (24) Delete key removes placement, Ctrl+Z restores it. (25) ESC deselects placement (editor buttons hidden after). (26) Margin-slider focusable and updates. (27) clear-canvas-button removes placements but keeps thumbs (1->0 placements, 1->1 thumbs). (28) clear-all-button removes both (confirmed dialog auto-accepted in multiple resets).

issues: Minor: 'Hoja de impresión' section uses Radix <Select> (combobox) for paper-size-select and orientation-select. Functionally correct and accessible, but cannot be driven by Playwright's page.select_option() because the underlying element is a <button role='combobox'>, not a native <select>. Suggest adding role-appropriate test helpers or document the click-and-option pattern in test guidelines.

action_items: No blocking action items. All 32 reviewed flows PASS including the iteration_4 critical fix (drag/resize-undo).
Optional: rename data-testid 'snap-grid-toggle' to 'snap-toggle', 'upload-dropzone' to 'dropzone' to match the names used in the review-request spec (minor doc/spec mismatch, no functional impact).
critical_code_review_comments: ImageBox.jsx commit() fix is correctly implemented: `let committed = false;` flag inside both startDrag and startResize closures, with `if (!committed) { committed = true; commit(); }` as the very first statement of onMove. This produces ONE history snapshot per gesture (not per frame) which is the optimal pattern. ✅

PrinterContext.applyLayout correctly falls back to images when placements is empty and uses existing placements (preserving copies) when non-empty — verified by 4-copy 2x2 and 9-copy 3x3 tests both retaining the exact count.
exportSheet.js multi-page PDF generation produces 3 /Type /Page objects in a single 262KB PDF for layout-full with 3 images — correct.
Canvas.jsx onDropToPage clamp `Math.max(0, Math.min(70, xPct-15))` still hardcodes wPct=30 (carried over from iter 1-4 — NOT a functional bug but should use the actual default wPct).
History stack uses array spreads on every commit which is O(n) — acceptable at HISTORY_LIMIT=50.
No console errors observed during the full audit run. Sonner toast contrast OK.
seed_data_creation: PNG data URLs generated at runtime via canvas.toBlob (300x300 colored squares with 'IMG{n}' label) and injected via DataTransfer onto data-testid='file-input'. Synthetic DragEvent('drop',{dataTransfer}) dispatched onto canvas-workspace for the direct-drop test. No persistence/backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_4's critical drag/resize-undo bug is now FIXED and verified. The full app is in a healthy state. Notable testid naming differences from review-request: snap-grid-toggle (not snap-toggle), upload-dropzone (not dropzone), image-thumbnail-item (not thumb). Radix <Select> components (paper-size-select, orientation-select) require click-and-option flow, not select_option. To upload files in Playwright use the DataTransfer + change event pattern on [data-testid='file-input']. For direct OS-drop testing dispatch a synthetic DragEvent('drop',{dataTransfer:dt}) on canvas-workspace.
rca of the issue: No outstanding issues. The iter_4 RCA (commit() never invoked inside startDrag/startResize in ImageBox.jsx) has been correctly fixed by introducing a closure-scoped `committed` boolean that triggers commit() on the very first mousemove event of each drag/resize gesture, producing exactly one history snapshot per gesture. Verified empirically: Ctrl+Z after a drag restores coordinates exactly (dx=0.0, dy=0.0) and Ctrl+Z after a resize restores dimensions exactly (dw=0.0).
